comments.author: Professor House
comments.body_html: Would it be possible to somehow increase the brightness of T-7 thermals? The Whitehot palette is nearly unusable because the brightness is so low, making the surroundings really hard to navigate.

comments.author: TEOA
comments.body_html:
Unlike NVGs the T7 have a few more values that control the color palette and it would be difficult to implement a user-friendly control of those very hard to understand values

But if you are willing to change the values yourself and understand them then take a look at the config.

“full”: { “HeatMin”: 0, “ColdMax”: 1, “ColorCoef”: 1 }, “limited”: { “HeatMin”: 0.4, “ColdMax”: 0.25, “ColorCoef”: 1.5 }The “full” / “limited” decide weather or not the entire heat range is detected or if it should capped.
I strongly recommend “limited”
The “ColorCoef” is a multiplier of heat intensity as far as I am aware but i might be wrong.

If you figure out a better preset for the WhiteHot mode please let me know and I will set it as default.
